name: GOV.UK Design System
stdout:
wrote eval/drift/govuk/survey.json
wrote eval/drift/govuk/report.json

Surveyed 3 page-viewport pairs, 1531 rendered elements, measured 2026-10-08.

  system size      18 values describe the site
  colour coverage  99.4% of the colour on the page
  spacing step     5px, explaining 42%
  sprawl           5.7x more distinct values than tokens
  waste            2 indistinguishable colours, 0% of the page

· 70 distinct colours render across the pages surveyed. 8 of them account for 99.4% of the colour on the page.
· 2 colours sit within a just-noticeable difference of a colour already in use and cannot be told apart by eye — together 0% of the colour on the page. The heaviest is #F3F9F9, which is 1.7 from #F4F8FB.
· Spacing follows no consistent step. The closest candidate is 5px and it explains only 42%.
· 11 spacing values sit off that step, the most frequent being 1px, which is 1px from the nearest multiple.
· 7 distinct font sizes are in use across 7 steps. The sizes sit on roughly a 1.188 ratio.
· 3 of those sizes carry under 1% of the text each, which is the signature of a one-off rather than a step.
· 1 corner radii are in use, clustering into 1 steps.
· 2 distinct shadows are in use. An elevation scale usually has two or three.
